prompt: I'm using huggingface to fine-tune LLAMA, but I only have several GPU servers with small GPU memory. How to split the model to different GPU servers, so that I can fine-tune LLAMA
response: To fine-tune LLAMA across multiple GPU servers with limited memory, you can use the `accelerate` library from Hugging Face, which supports data and model parallelism. Use the `DeepSpeedStrategy` to shard the model across GPUs. Ensure your dataset is distributed evenly and adjust the batch size accordingly. This setup allows efficient training without needing large GPUs.
